verdict.rationale: LlamaParse's own docs list a batch-processing example for Parse, and webhook notifications on job completion or failure support asynchronous job handling instead of polling. There is no evidence of documented rate limits, throughput figures, or operation at millions-of-pages scale. Missing for 10: documented rate limits/quotas, predictable throughput or SLA figures, evidence of millions-of-page batch scale, independent or hands-on corroboration of high-volume performance.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I push high-volume batches — millions of pages — with documented rate limits and predictable throughput

citations.quote: Instead of continuously polling for status updates, you can configure webhook endpoints to be notified immediately when jobs complete, fail, or reach other states.
